CustomObject.description: One inbound webhook signing secret, keyed on the vendor's identifier for the webhook. Asana hands its secret over at runtime during the registration handshake, one per webhook, which rules out both of the usual homes: a Named Credential injects credentials on outbound calls and cannot hand a key to code that has to compute an HMAC itself, and Apex cannot write Custom Metadata synchronously. Private, no sharing rules, no sharing sets. The Secret__c field is readable by the integration owner only and deliberately not by the site guest - the code, not FLS, is what protects it on the guest path, because Apex runs in system mode.
CustomObject.label: Webhook Secret
